title: Load tiers list — table renders with active and inactive tiers
expected: Table is visible with columns Name, Rank, Status, Actions. Active tiers show a dark 'Active' badge; inactive tiers show a grey 'Inactive' badge. Rows are ordered by rank ascending.

title: Create a tier — fill name + rank, submit; tier appears in list
expected: Dialog closes, success toast 'Tier created' appears, list refetches and the new 'Senior Trainer' row (rank 2, Active status) appears in the table.
persistence: trainer_tiers table: name='Senior Trainer', rank=2, is_active=true

title: Missing-rate-categories banner appears after create/reactivate when categories have no rate for the new tier
steps: Ensure at least one active categoryCommissionConfig exists with no commissionTierRate for the target tier
Create a new tier (or reactivate an existing one)
Observe the page after dialog closes
expected: An Alert (destructive variant) appears above the table listing category IDs that lack a commission rate for the new tier. Banner reads: 'The following categories don't have a commission rate for this tier yet.'
_partial_reason: Banner renders raw categoryId UUIDs (trainer-tiers-page.tsx:126), not human-readable category names. No dismiss button on the banner — once shown it persists for the entire page session with no way to clear it.

title: Deactivate a tier — confirmation dialog → confirm → tier status becomes inactive
steps: Navigate to tiers tab with at least one active tier
Click 'Deactivate' on an active tier row
Confirm dialog appears showing tier name
expected: Dialog closes, success toast 'Tier deactivated' appears, list refetches, the tier's status badge changes from 'Active' to 'Inactive' and its action button changes to 'Reactivate'.

title: Reactivate a tier — click Reactivate on inactive row → tier becomes active; banner if missing rates
steps: Ensure at least one inactive tier exists
Observe the row and any banner
expected: Success toast 'Tier reactivated' appears, list refetches, tier badge changes to 'Active', action button changes to 'Deactivate'. If missingRateCategories is non-empty, the warning banner appears.

title: Create tier with duplicate name (case-insensitive) — backend returns error
expected: Backend returns BAD_REQUEST with message 'A tier with this name already exists'. Toast error is shown. Dialog remains open. No new DB row inserted.
